scores.notes: Viewed full size and cropped heads: both are elderly with long white beards, but the left Moses has a full head of long white hair while the right Moses has a bald crown with white hair only at the sides. A hair-style conflict, so different.

The left path runs between a single wall of water and desert cliffs and dunes; the right path runs between two walls of water with a pillar of fire ahead. The arrangement of water and land conflicts, so different.

Viewed cropped heads: the left Peter has black curly hair and a black beard and looks younger; the right Peter has grey curly hair and a grey beard and looks older. Night lighting does not explain the grey, so different.
